I couldn't do this research. My first attempt to fetch the source pages failed with "no more code_execution tool calls remaining this turn," and so did a second test call. That tool is my only way to reach the approved sites; the other tools have no internet access. So I read none of the pages, including Enduring Word, Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Precept Austin, NET Bible notes, Wesley, Catholic and Orthodox sources, or any others.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and give a URL for every point. I could write notes on Job 2 from general knowledge, but they wouldn't be sourced, so I've left all three sections empty.

When the tool is available again, re-run this request and I'll start with these pages:

- **Verse-by-verse (traditional reading):** enduringword.com/bible-commentary/job-2/ and biblehub.com/commentaries/[gill | ellicott | pulpit]/job/2.htm. I'll also look for Job 2 on preceptaustin.org; I don't have its exact URL yet.
- **Tradition differences:** Wesley's notes on Job 2 (wesley.nnu.edu), Matthew Henry and Spurgeon on Job 2:10, and Reformed sources on God's sovereignty and Satan's limits (vv. 3, 6, 10).
- **Other views:**
  - netbible.org notes on "skin for skin," "bless/curse" and the meaning of "the satan."
  - bibleodyssey.org on the satan figure.
  - Catholic and Orthodox readings, possibly including patristic texts on Job's wife.
  - gotquestions.org on word of faith claims about Job's "fear," Job's wife, and the friends' silence.
